item: Pending-item busy composition for session tabs (per-tab pending queue; a queued user prompt keeps the tab busy, parked synthetic repeats do not).
reason: No live producer carries a per-tab pending queue to the TUI. The helper methods exist but have zero live callers, and the only run queue that exists is (a) owned solely by the active session and (b) already published to the composer dock, not the tab strip.

dead_helpers_no_live_caller.note: struct + indicator_text(1942) + EMPTY_TAB_STATUS(1839) have zero non-test callers across the workspace (rtk grep over crates/ excluding native_tabs.rs == 0 matches)

live_busy_path_today.note: family roll-up: descendant WorkState::Running marks root busy
indicator_label paints spinner only from flags.busy

live_queue_exists_but_wrong_consumer.note: queued_drafts: VecDeque<(Option<String> owner, String text)> - the ONLY run queue in the CLI
Queue plan pushes owner = live active session id only; a background tab's queue is never accumulated
publishable_queued_prompts filters to the active session and feeds the composer dock (:8627), NOT the tab strip

live_snapshot_lacks_field.note: LiveSnapshot (573-604) carries no per-tab pending queue; no pending field reaches navigation or TabStatus

missing_seam.producer_required: A live per-session pending queue projected to the tab strip. Two absent pieces: (1) a server event/payload exposing per-session pending items with a kind discriminator (user vs synthetic), and (2) a CLI consumer that maps each session's queue into TabInput/TabStatus.

oc2_gap_confirmed.quote: The upstream session.inbox.update / session.inbox.cancel routes have no oc2 server endpoint yet

missing_seam.consequences: Wiring enqueue_user_prompt/member_busy to queued_drafts would only ever observe the ACTIVE session, so background tabs could never show queued-busy; that is a fabricated partial behavior, not the upstream family-aggregated fact. A new server-side per-session pending projection + event is required first.

focused_test_plan_when_unblocked: server: GET /api/sessions exposes per-session pending items with type user|synthetic; unit-test both kinds
cli: background session with one User pending item paints the dots spinner; Synthetic-only paints no spinner
cli: family roll-up - a descendant's pending user item marks the root busy (upstream :171-176)
